semantic.justification: Native md4c block/span/text callbacks now dispatch directly to the Writer parser and actual pool items. Retains itemless stack entries, raw href attributes, ignored entity/NULL/math callbacks, image-text suppression and block-only HTML buffering. Application language uses the existing shared configured system-locale field binding. HTMLReader/CSS integration, task control ownership, graphic nodes, complete numbering format metadata and compiled Writer differential remain open. Markdown hyperlink callbacks now use the actual native INetURLObject::GetAbsURL strict-relative path, replacing browser URL resolution. This preserves original default-argument conversion-failure fallback, host/port spelling, absolute-path dot segments, query-only directory resolution and leading-fragment shortcut. Actual MarkdownReader/SwDoc hyperlink tests distinguish these cases; no complete Markdown/filter or compiled Writer parity promotion is made.
